selection_objective: Highest development winner accuracy among candidates with lower log loss and non-worse Brier than the incumbent; ties use lower log loss. Independent prospective promotion checks still apply.
fold_policy: Original shared 40/60/80 percent expanding date folds

comparison_uncertainty.note: Descriptive weekly block intervals after candidate selection; selection uncertainty is not included. These are not independent promotion evidence.

note: Research only. All confirmation games remain in the denominator, including missing box histories. The confirmation period has been reported before; this follow-up is not an untouched test and does not promote or replace live weights. No candidate is selected on confirmation accuracy.

confirmation.note: Historical confirmation of specifications selected on pre-July 2025 results, both trained on the same recent history. The current season and original archived test are excluded. This is not prospective promotion evidence.
